description:
Location: crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs:68-69

```rust
/// Minimal error type for `MemoryBackend`.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct MemoryError(pub String);
```

The inner `String` is `pub`. Three contract consequences:

1. **Forever-public tuple-struct field.** Once shipped, callers can
   pattern-match `MemoryError(s) if s.contains("not found")` — a
   pattern that locks the implementation to a String-formatted error
   text. A future evolution to `MemoryError { kind: ErrorKind, ctx:
   Box<dyn Error> }` is a breaking change. The fix is either to make
   the field private (with a `fn message(&self) -> &str` accessor)
   or to mark the struct `#[non_exhaustive]` so struct-literal
   construction is blocked from outside the crate.

2. **Missing `#[non_exhaustive]`.** Independent of point 1, the type
   itself is not marked. Adding a second field is a breaking change.
   Both the field-private AND non_exhaustive treatments are cheap.

3. **Implementation leakage.** Tying the only-error-shape to "string
   description" leaks the prototype-quality of the reference impl
   into the public type system. Database-backed backends will
   implement their own error type and not use `MemoryError` — but
   downstream contributors studying the reference impl will copy
   this pattern as if it were canonical. Document or restrict.

Propagation note: canonical sibling
`crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs:449-452` has the same shape
(`pub struct MemoryError(pub String)`) — fix mail-server first per
the workspace propagation rule, then propagate. Both type defs
should land the same treatment in the same pass.

Suggested fix: 

```rust
#[non_exhaustive]
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct MemoryError {
    message: String,
}

impl MemoryError {
    pub fn message(&self) -> &str { &self.message }
}
```

…or move the type to `pub(crate)` and adjust `tests/common/mod.rs`
to construct/inspect via the public `Error` trait surface.
title: pub struct MemoryError(pub String) exposes inner String as a public field, blocks structured-error evolution
